[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (operations: List Int) : Bool :=
let rec loop (ops: List Int) (i: Nat) (balance: Int) (result: Bool) : Bool :=
  match ops with
  | [] => result
  | head :: tail =>
    let new_balance := balance + head
    if new_balance < 0 then
      true
    else
      loop tail (i + 1) new_balance result
loop operations 0 0 false
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation operations
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  have h_loop := loop
  have h_base_case := h_loop []
  have h_loop_step := h_loop (head :: tail) (i + 1) (balance + head) result
  have h_result := h_loop_step
  simp [h_result]
  by_cases h_result: result
  -- Case 1: result = true
  simp [h_result]
  have h_loop_true := h_loop_step
  simp [h_loop_true]
  have h_loop_true_i := h_loop_true (i + 1) (balance + head) result
  simp [h_loop_true_i]
  have h_balance := h_loop_true_i (i + 1) (balance + head) result
  simp [h_balance]
  have h_balance_neg := h_balance (i + 1) (balance + head) result
  simp [h_balance_neg]
  have h_balance_neg_sum := h_balance_neg (i + 1) (balance + head) result
  simp [h_balance_neg_sum]
  simp [List.take, List.sum]
  simp [List.sum_take]
  simp [List.sum]
